question: Which collective powers are asked to protect the speaker continually?
premises: The Yoginīs are asked to protect always
The Mudrās are asked to protect always
The speaker seeks their ongoing guardianship
inference: The Yoginīs and Mudrās are invoked as constant collective protectors of the speaker.
uncertainties: Mudrāḥ may refer to goddess powers rather than hand gestures in this context.
plain_english: May the Yoginīs always protect; may the Mudrās always protect me.
